baseline.scope: Implementation-only AST parsing and symbol extraction; warmed grammar and corpus loaded before timing. Excludes file I/O, SQL, chunking, model calls and end-to-end indexing.

candidate.scope: Implementation-only AST parsing and symbol extraction; warmed grammar and corpus loaded before timing. Excludes file I/O, SQL, chunking, model calls and end-to-end indexing.

method: Five sequential extraction passes per revision over the same frozen 182 Python files; separate source imports, no remote models. Host also running background blackbox indexing; observational component cost only.
